segments.en: Hey, Kanji, what's this talk about?
And you only called the folks who came down from space...
Is this about Grados...?

That battle just now...
we might be the reason it happened.

Not that us getting off the ship now
would change anything, though.

But hold on, how does Grados
even know about us in the first place?
About that...

Grados and Binzvanker might
already be in contact.
You remember the Konpei Island Fleet, right?

Oh, yeah...
The Giganos Army was in on it too!

And when we came to this continent,
Omega made contact with us too.

Looks like Binzvanker is trying
to join hands with the powers
of every world out there.

They've even set up peaceful relations
with the Earth Federation...

Sounds like a real slippery customer,
this Binzvanker.

But they're not people who honestly
want peace. They're keeping quiet
for now, but...

I sense it too.
Leaving them alone is dangerous.
Quess's intuition, huh...

Anyway, for now all we can do is
protect the Iron Gear with everything
we've got...!
Everyone, are we agreed?
Yeah!
Okay, you got it!

rows.notes: Seg 8: [jp] = Konpei Island fleet (elf_strings has Konpei Island Combined Fleet). Seg 1: blank header, read as Kaine continuing ('and only gathering the ones who came down from space'). Segs 12-15: Binzvanker referred to as 'they'/'this Binzvanker' (gender/nature not settled; Amuro's [jp] is plural). | [editorial 8] project term: Konpei Island Fleet (capital F) | [proofread 9] style sheet: 'the Giganos Army' (army name)

segments.en: Are the ship's repairs done?

Yes...
We can move out right away.
I'll guide you to the Resistance hideout.

You should be able to resupply there.
It might not be enough, though...
But...
Hey, Elchi, why not?

I don't like the way Grados does
things either.

Working to free this country
doesn't sound so bad to me.

Jiron... we're haulers.
...We're not saviors.
No more... I've had enough of seeing blood!

Hmm~...
Such cultured words, I'm sure...

Haulers have rules of their own,
you know.

If you want to trade across borders,
the iron rule is never to meddle in
how a country runs things...!
If we joined the Resistance...!
Then what're we gonna do from here!

Either way, we're "outlaws" now.
We can't even get off this continent!

That's exactly it! I don't understand
why this suddenly happened to us!!

It's because we outsiders are
aboard this ship.
But there's no turning back now, is there?

Yikes...
She just came right out and said
the thing nobody wanted to say...
What do you mean?
We have no choice but to keep going forward.
We should cooperate with the Resistance!

You lot! You were "outlaws"
from the very start, weren't you!
That's not true.

No, Quess. It's better that we
make that clear...

It's true that Kanji, Kaine's group
and I share a common enemy.

Whether that enemy is connected
to Grados isn't clear yet...
But Grados is clearly after us.

I don't really get it. A common enemy...
What kind of enemy is it?

Sooner or later, it will become
the enemy of this entire world.

You just got involved a little earlier
than everyone else.

We're not in the war business!
We're haulers!

Why don't you lot just go help
the Resistance on your own?

Even if we got off now, the Iron Gear
would still be targeted.
You've got some nerve saying that!

Blume! This is no time to be
saying stuff like that, is it?
What was that?!
Knock it off!

We were Sand Rats to begin with...!
We're not haulers born and bred.
Rag...

Heh! Why not?
I've made up my mind too.

You lot have bailed us out
plenty of times.

Come on! The Grados Army's coming,
so we can't dawdle!

Let's head out!
Elchi!
Jiron...
All right...
Let's go to the Resistance hideout!

Damn...
You've all lost your minds...

rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'haulers' throughout (Iron Gear traders). Seg 10: Jiron mockingly echoes Elchi's 'culture' talk in feminine speech; kept as a sarcastic 'Such cultured words'. [jp] = 'Sand Rats' (glossary position for Blume; library also has 'Sandrats'). | [accuracy 9] deliberate pause after kore ijou restored | [editorial 15] [jp] = "outlaws" in quotes, as in dlg_3983_09438_01 rows 16/18 | [editorial 17] 'riding on this ship' awkward | [editorial 23] [jp] = "outlaws" (was "wanted"); consistent with k15 and previous unit | [editorial 32] accuracy flag: sensouya contrasts with hakobiya as a trade; 'warmongers' means war advocates | [editorial 43] project term: the Grados Army

segments.en: Eiji, I'm putting up a marker now.

Is the Resistance base
somewhere around here?

Yeah...
It's roughly around there.

Allll right,
let's move out!

Hey, Eiji, the Grados forces chasing us
still haven't shown up?

We're moving away from
Grados headquarters.

Maybe we managed to shake off
our pursuers.

Come to think of it,
where is Grados headquarters?
Their headquarters is far to the south.

In the city that used to be called
New York.

New York...
Until not long ago, it was
the center of culture...

Now they've even banned calling
that city New York.
That's right...

This is it.
There should be a secret base
underground around here.

What's that?
What was that explosion?!
No way...!

Th-This is...
Resistance base...

E-Eiji!
Stay away!!

Hey!!
You bastard!!
Guhh!!

Ahahahaha~
Guess I squeezed a little too hard!
Did I squash it flat?

So you were alive!
Gosterro!!

Alive?
Well now, who knows!

Who can say how much of this body
is actually alive!!
Fuhahahaha!

Eijiii~! At long last,
I get my revenge on you!

Stop! We surrendered!
You promised to spare our lives!

Ahahahahaha~!
I just looove killing people!
Gwaaaaah!

This is why I can never
give up killing!
Gaaaaah!
Eeeeek!
Drop deaaad~~!
Stooooop!!
Eahahahaha!

This is so much fun,
my brain's about to boil over!
I'll slaughter every last one of you!
Gyaaaaah!

Deehahaha,
I can't get enough of this!

Th-This is horrible...
Battle stations!!
We're rescuing the Resistance!
That's more like it!

rows.notes: Seg 7: [jp] -- the crushed victim's gender is unknown, so Gosterro says 'Did I squash it flat?' (callous 'it'). Seg 3: the transmission is cut off mid-sentence; kept unfinished.

segments.en:
Come on, Gosterro!
Face me!!
Eahahahaha!

Don't think you'll get to fight me
fair and square!
An ambush!
Soft as ever, aren't you~~!!

We meet again,
kid!

Dammit!
Even Timp's here!

You lot! I'll finish off
every la~st one of you myself!
Nuahahaha!

Boss!!
We can't take any more!

Don't call me Boss!
I told you to call me Captain!!
All forces, retreat!

You got it,
Boss!
Tch!

Iron Gear...
not bad at all...

Those guys fight on a whole other level
from your run-of-the-mill Breakers.

Heh heh...
No wonder they're targets.

Uooooooh, I'm not gonna die
from something like this~!!

Daaaamn iiit~~~!
You'll pay for this~~~!

rows.notes: [editorial 6] capitalisation: 'Breaker(s)' capitalised across the corpus and glossary | [proofread 1] capitalisation: 'Boss' / 'Captain' as forms of address (k0/k3 'Boss'; Elchi's 'Call me Captain!' in dlg_3983_09438_00)

segments.en:
Phew... looks like our friends
finally pulled back.

Hey, Eiji, that Gosterro guy...
isn't he out of his damn mind?
Pretty much...
Are all Gradosians like that?

Idiot! If all Gradosians were like that,
they could never even build SPTs!

That's right...
Gosterro is a special case.

Anyway, rescuing the base's survivors
comes first right now.
Let's hurry!

rows.notes: [editorial 3] project term: Gradosian(s) (used in the very next page)

segments.en:
It's quiet...
Did everyone... get wiped out?

That can't be.
There's a secret shelter here.
This way!
So this is the shelter...?!

Heyyy!
Is anybody alive in there?!

We're friends.
It's Eiji, of the Layzner!
Is anybody there?

Eiji!
Everyone, it's okay now.
You can come out!

Eiji...
So you made it to the Iron Gear
safely.

Yeah...
By the way, what happened
to the others?

No need to worry.
Headquarters has moved elsewhere.

The attack came so suddenly that
we couldn't get word to you,
Eiji...
Then why did you all stay behind?

We're the unit that stayed behind
to throw the enemy off the scent.

Besides, if nobody had stayed,
you'd have been in a fix, right?

I see... I owe you one.
Are there no other survivors?

In the last battle, half of the unit
ended up scattered...

Nah!
They're a tough bunch.
We'll meet up with them sooner or later...!
You're right.

Eiji, let's get everyone moved
onto the ship, and fast.
The enemy might come back.
Right.

rows.notes: Several different Resistance Members speak (polite one uses [jp], casual one uses plain [jp]); segs 4 and 6-7 keep that contrast through register only. [jp] = 'Headquarters'. | [editorial 11] accuracy flag: sumanai answers 'you'd have been in a fix' -- gratitude, 'I'm sorry' read as an apology

segments.en:
Um, you're one of the Iron Gear's
people, aren't you?
Yeah... that's right.

Thank you for your help.
Let us fight the tyranny of Grados
together!
Oh, uh, sure...!

Staying behind was worth it! Watching
you guys drive Grados off felt great!

Looking forward to fighting
alongside you!

Same here!
I'm glad to have you with us!

Everyone, move to the Iron Gear
right away. I'm counting on you
to guide us to the new hideout.

Yeah!
Leave it to me.
The Resistance has joined the unit.

rows.notes: [editorial 9] system line aligned to '<name> has joined the unit.'

segments.en:
So in the end, all that
trouble for nothing...!

We're already aboard this boat,
so stick with it to the end.

We've got more allies now,
so what's wrong with that?

You're way too happy-go-lucky,
you know that?!
All right, let's get going!
Head for the Resistance base.

rows.notes: Seg 1: [jp] (idiom: once you've boarded the boat, see it through) kept as a boat image, which also fits the Iron Gear.

segments.en:
Whoa there!
Got a hit on the sensors.
There's a ship approaching.
Grados forces?

No...
I can't tell yet.

Is that the ship?
The one Gosterro
failed to finish off!

Yes!
That hull type is definitely
the Iron Gear!

Eiji...
I'll make you pay for
Captain Gale's death!

rows.notes: [jp] romanized 'Gale' (Layzner's Gale; not in the glossary). [jp] = 'Captain' (unit leader title). | [editorial 3] 'botched the job against' awkward

segments.en: Eiji, what's that ship?

No doubt about it.
It's a Grados ship!

At last you show yourself before me,
Eiji!!
You're...!

Don't you dare say
you've forgotten!

You betrayed Grados and took
Captain Gale's life! I...
will never forgive you!!

(I deserted the army and headed for
Terra to warn the people there
about the threat of Grados.)

(But... as a result... I ended up
bringing down Gale, my own
senior officer......)

Back then... I couldn't control
the Layzner's V-MAX...

And because of that,
Gale...

Eiji!
Today I'll finally destroy you!
Prepare yourself!!

All right!
Let's intercept them!!

All hands!
Battle stations!!

rows.notes: Seg 8: [jp] = Gale as Eiji's senior in the Grados army; 'my own senior officer'. Seg 10 trails off deliberately. | [accuracy 5] deliberate pause in watashi wa... restored

segments.en:
We... can't hold out.
Please fall back!

D-Damn you!!
Next time for sure!!

You've got all kinds of people
gunning for you, huh.

I betrayed my homeland.
It can't be helped...

We're almost at the rendezvous point.
If we wait there, someone will come
to meet us.

Roger!
Let's get back on course.
Is it around here?

Yeah, spot on.
Stop the ship.

Well?
Just like I said, right?

They're planning to meet up
with the Resistance here.
Heh heh... good work.

Listen up, you lot!
We're storming the Iron Gear
in hand-to-hand combat!!

Got that?!
Kill every last one of them!!

Whaaat?!
Weren't we supposed to capture
Elchi, the captain...?

If you want to save her,
you'd better be the first one aboard!
N-No way!!

Hahahaha!! Fools who defy Grados!
I'll carve up every last one of you!
A-All forces, chaaarge!!
Yeahhh!!

Hm?
Somebody's running this way.

Whoa~
That's a lot of people.
Is that the Resistance?

Heyyy! You guys!
Are you with the Resistance?
Wh-Whoaaaaaa!!
Chaaarge!!

Don't fall behind the Security Force!
Show 'em a Breaker's pride!
Uraaaaah!!

Nuahahahaha!
Kill them aaall!!

Whoaaaa!
We're under attack~!!
It's Horla and Gosterro!

Elchi! We're under attack!
Horla and Gosterro are charging in
on foot!!
What did you say?!
Everyone, it's hand-to-hand!!

Anyone in the hangar,
guard your own machines!!

The enemy got inside...!
Where's Kanji?!

He went to the bridge and
hasn't come back!

Whoa!!
They're here already!
Hiyaaaah!!
Ow!!

That bitch!
She got me!!
Nyeh!!

Hey, Quess!
Don't egg them on so much!

Everyone, it's dangerous outside!!
Get into your machines right now!!

Protecting our own machines
is our top priority!

Got it!
Will do!!

All right!
I'm gonna run right through 'em!
Yeah!

Let's launch and back them up
from outside the ship!

I see.
So we cut off the enemy's
reinforcements.

Agreed! Well then,
let's bust on through!

Hey! Hey!
Move it, or I'll squash
you flat!!

What?!
They're launching?!
Stop them!!
Dwaaaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

There's a huge number of soldiers
gathering around the ship...!

Amuro and the others just
headed out in their machines.

Let's leave the ones outside
to Amuro's group for now.

My Resistance comrades should
be here soon. If we can hold out,
we'll manage somehow.

Until then, we've got to drive
the enemy off the ship...

Blume!
I'm leaving the bridge to you.
Take care of things here.

Huh?
Don't tell me you want me
to guard the bridge alone?

The entrance is narrow,
so handle it by yourself!

Blume,
we're counting on you!

Everyone else,
follow me!

We're driving the enemy
off the Iron Gear!!

Whew~!
Ain't she gallant!

Hahahahaha!
Why not?
That's Elchi for you!

Heh!
You said it.

Been a while since our last brawl.
Time we showed 'em some
Sand Rats grit too!

Allll right!
Let's gooo!!

Kanji!!
Let's go too!
H-Hang on a sec.

Hand-to-hand or not, I don't have
any decent weapons.

And besides...
will Blume be okay on his own?

Better than babysitting you!
Get going already!!
Y-Yeah...

rows.notes: Segs 14-16: blank-header pages read as Jiron (he sees the runners; seg 17 is his scream). Seg 19: blank header, read as Horla continuing. Seg 32: [jp] kept at full strength ('That bitch!'). Seg 33: [jp] (tongue-out taunt) = 'Nyeh!!'. [jp] = hand-to-hand combat. | [editorial 12] battle-cry ooo- answering 'Charge!'; 'Ooooh!!' read as admiration; matches the crew's 'Yeahhh!' in the previous unit | [editorial 19] capitalisation: Breaker | [editorial 38] hashirinukeru = dash through (to his machine); 'make a run for it' means fleeing

segments.en:
Forget the machines!
Just keep the pilots
from getting near them!

Horla!
You again?!
Miss Elchi!

I can't protect you
any longer!!

Hmph! So you've sunk to being
a Grados lackey,
have you!

If you mean to protect me,
betray Grados right now!

Ngh...
No use saying anything to her.

Then I'll make you listen,
by force if I have to!
And I won't go easy on you either!!

Dammit!
What's with these people?!

Heh! We were raised a whole lot
tougher than you!

Rag!
Something nasty's
coming from over there!
What?
Hm, that's...!

Mr. Gosterro!!
Over here!
That prey is miiine~!
Gwah!
Gosterro!!

Nwahahahaha~
I'll make every bone in your
bodies creak~
I'll slaughter every last one of you!

We're outnumbered...
If I could just get into my FT,
I could do something...!

Don't give up.
My comrades will be here
to help soon!

That's right!
Hang in there until
Eiji's comrades arrive!

Give it up!
With odds like these,
you don't stand a chance!

Hey!
Ganging up on a delicate lady,
isn't that a cowardly thing to do?!

I just love the words
"brute force"~
Ahahahaha~
U-Uhyaaaah!

Damn it~
That hurt, you know!

Captain Gosterro!
The 3rd Platoon's been wiped out!!
Enemy reinforcements incoming!!

What?
Don't screw with me!

W-Well...
The enemy's mobile weapons have
them pinned down!
Whaaat~!
Tch, what a pain in the neck.

Heh heh heh~!
You lot are my prey.
I'll never let you get away!!
We'll see about that.

Y-You!
When did you get here?!!
Guhoh!!

Ngh...
More of them?

Looks like we made it in time,
bro!
So it seems...
Hey, you bastard!

We have risen up
to bring down Grados!

Not content with ruling by force,
you commit act after act of tyranny.

I, George de Sand,
cannot allow it!
That's right!

I'm on the Resistance's side too,
so there!!

Anyone who torments innocent people
gets knocked flat by me!

I swear it on the fist
of the King of Hearts!!
Th-That crest...!!

He's the champion of the Continental
Fighting Tournament! The King of
Hearts!! Domon Kasshu!!
No way... it can't be...

No doubt about it! That's the mark
of the King of Hearts!

Well, I'll be...
Who knew someone like that
was in the Resistance?

I don't really get it,
but he's on our side?
Yeah, exactly.

Thanks in part to their help, the
Resistance's activities are
growing bigger by the day.

B-Boss!
We can't beat them
no matter what!!

Seriously...
A guy like that,
in the Resistance...
Don't panic!!

<Win Condition>
Defeat Gosterro within the time limit
or drive off the enemy vehicles.

rows.notes: Seg 38 / row 22 seg 10: [jp] (this game's continent-based fighting competition, standing in for the Gundam Fight) rendered 'Continental Fighting Tournament'; not in the glossary, please verify. Seg 36: reading gloss [jp] dropped. Seg 27: [jp] (Sai Saici to Domon) = 'bro'. Seg 45: [jp] = Horla addressed as 'Boss'. Seg 48: [jp] = '<Win Condition>' (form used in another slice). | [accuracy 23] soitsu wa dou ka na is a challenge to Gosterro's boast ('I doubt it'), not a neutral 'Is that so?' | [editorial 26] accuracy flag: arate, 'Newcomers?' weak; matches 'More of them!?' (dlg_3983_09438_01 r18 k17) | [proofread 24] question ending in '!!' -> '?!!' (style sheet doubled form)

segments.en:
Nghaaaah~~
M-My brain hurts~!

Captain Gosterro
went down?!

Like I said, we can't
beat 'em!

Fall back!
Hurry, run for it!

H-Hey!
You lot!!
Don't run off on your own!!

Horla!
Give it up!

Grrgh...!
I'm pulling out for today!

Come at us as many times
as you like!

My, my...
They scattered like baby spiders,
didn't they...

No...
There's still one left.

Ugh, it hurts~
I'm gonna die~
I'm done for~
Hey... are you okay?

Look out, Kanji!
Don't get any closer!!

Uooooooh, I'm not gonna die
from something like this~!
Wh-Whoa!!

Gnuuuuuh!! Someday, I swear,
I'll tear you lot limb from limb!

Kanji,
are you okay?
Yeah... you saved me.

That Gosterro guy...
he can take an unnatural
amount of punishment.

More importantly, bro!
Shouldn't we go after
Gosterro?

Our job is to guide the Iron Gear.
There's no need to chase him
too far.

Indeed. That man is half cyborg...
Capturing him would take
thorough preparation.

But y'know, if we let him get away,
I've got a feeling he'll just
keep doing nothing but bad stuff.

Maybe so...
It's true that finishing him off
right then would've been easy.

But...
we are not killers.
Don't forget that.

I know,
bro!

rows.notes: Seg 3: [jp] is in feminine speech under a generic Breaker header; kept neutral ('Fall back! Hurry, run for it!'). Seg 8: [jp] idiom kept literally ('like baby spiders'). | [editorial 6] 'I'll withdraw for today!' too stiff for Horla's casual voice

segments.en: Good work, Blume!

What a welcome that was,
seriously!!

I wish the Resistance would clean up
the enemy before we show up.
Come on, don't say that.

You'll be shocked when you see
who came to pick us up.

Huh?
What's that supposed to mean?
So this is the bridge.

Whoa~
Nice view, huh?

It retains a nostalgic air...
A fine ship indeed.

Ah... ah......
You guys... could you be...!

Surprised? These are genuine regulars
of the Continental Fighting
Tournament!

Then that guy is the King of Hearts...
Domon Kasshu?
Yep, it's the real deal!
No way...?!

Comrades from every nation are
gathering in the Resistance now.

We came over from the neighboring
Asia Continent to lend a hand.

I know that.
You're Sai Saici of Neo China,
right?

The Grados Army has advanced
even into the Asia Continent
that we protect.

Not just here on the Gaia Continent --
the whole Terra Realm is in
great turmoil right now.

Well, the details can wait
until we reach the base.

I'll guide you to the base right away.
Could you correct your course?
Aye aye!!

Domon, Sai Saici and George
have joined the unit.

Kanji gained hand-to-hand combat
experience. From now on, he is
registered as a Warrior.

rows.notes: [jp] / [jp] / [jp] = 'Gaia Continent' / 'Asia Continent' / 'Terra Realm' (forms used in elf_strings). [jp] = 'Warrior' (glossary: [jp]). | [editorial 17] project term: the Grados Army | [editorial 22] system line aligned to '<name> has joined the unit.'

segments.en: This is the Resistance base.

Huh~
From far off, it just looked like
plain rocky desert...

It didn't even show up on the D-3's
sensors. That's some camouflage.

Looks like nobody's
tailing us...

The main facilities are underground.
Keep heading straight in.
Roger!

Grados City
(formerly New York)
Grados Government Building

Three years have passed since we left
the Grados homeworld and came to
the far-off Terra Realm...

...and of Terra's six continents,
our forces have taken a mere two...

Our forces now invading the Asia
Continent have already subdued
70% of it.

Once the Asia Continent is pacified,
half of the Terra Realm will be
under our rule.

Yet the conquest of the Asia Continent
seems to be taking a great deal
of time.

Sir... As our territory has grown,
our units have been spread out
across the continent.

Resistance activity has also grown
fiercer, which further accelerates
the dispersal of our forces.

Hm...
Reinforcements will soon arrive
from the Grados homeworld.

Before they do, crush the
Resistance and make ready
for the offensive.
Sir!
Excuse me......

What?
I see... understood...

Your Excellency! A Terran with
Class-A collaborator status has come
to report on the war situation.
I will go and hear the report myself.

No...
Bring the Terran here.

Your Excellency...!
What did you say?

That Terran... is most likely
Roanne Demitrich. I have heard
the rumors.
Er...

I am told this is a capable Terran
who has sworn loyalty to Grados.
I wish to meet him for myself.

But this hall is a sacred place
that only Gradosians are
permitted to enter...

It matters not...
Send him in.
...Understood.

Roanne Demitrich!
Enter!!
I have a report, sir!!

According to word just in, the unit sent
to destroy the Iron Gear failed its mission
and appears to have been wiped out.

You mean to say that Gosterro
was beaten?!

Yes... The report comes from
a reliable reconnaissance unit!

Damn you... Iron Gear!
How dare you, mere haulers!!

Karla.
I hear that you, too, were defeated
by this Iron Gear.

N-No... I merely happened
to run into them while on patrol...

If I may be so bold
as to speak, sir!!

It appears the Iron Gear has made
contact with the Resistance and
strengthened its forces.

So it would seem...
We must organize a new
punitive force.

Roanne Demitrich,
you have done well!
Sir!
Ngh...

What is it,
Karla?

Heh heh...
That Terran is quite useful,
is it not?
Y-Yes...

rows.notes: Roanne's gender is blank in speakers.tsv: Gresco's lines use 'the Terran' / singular 'them' (seg 26) instead of he/she. [jp] = 'Terran' (Grados' word for the natives of Terra; not in the glossary). Seg 20: [jp] = 'Class-A collaborator'. Seg 7: [jp] = 'Government Building'. [jp] = 'D-3' (Light's Dragonar-3). Seg 9 continues Gresco's sentence from seg 8; leading '...' marks the continuation. | [accuracy 26] Roanne's gender is now settled (male in speakers.tsv / project decisions); singular 'them' replaced by 'him' | [accuracy 35] tadaka hakobiya no bunzai de: contempt 'how dare mere haulers' restored; 'You're nothing but haulers' lost the outrage | [editorial 26] 'meet him once' reads oddly for ichido atte okitai | [editorial 28] accuracy flag: Roanne is named in k24 and 'him' in k26, so 'the Terran' repeated is stiff

segments.en: New Grados Army Space Carrier

Lord Le Caine, we have just
passed through the gate.

Heh... So this is the continent
my father rules...

Now that I am here, all those
